news.title: Application Manager v3.1.2 Released
news.author: EthanAVideos
news.content: New features include News category, improved permissions handling, and better launch mode management.

news.title: New App Available: Multitool
news.author: EthanAVideos
news.content: Multitool is now available in the Software category. A versatile utility for file operations and system tasks.

news.title: LiveryWorks Editor Update
news.author: EthanAVideos
news.content: LiveryWorks Editor v1.6.9.B8 is now available with improved stability and new features.

news.title: Tips: Using Launch Modes
news.author: System
news.content: You can now toggle between Cloud and Local launch modes. Cloud uses the configured launch command, while Local uses the detected executable. Toggle in Settings or per-app Options menu.
